title: Hallucination to Consensus: Multi-Agent LLMs for End-to-End JUnit Test Generation
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
datasets: HumanEvalJava 160; LeetCodeJava 100 (50 medium/50 hard); each with three Pitest synthetic-mutant variants. Defects4J/SF110 explicitly excluded.
models: Llama 3.1 70B basic + DeepSeek-R1 Llama-distilled 70B reasoning, 3 panel pipelines; GPT-3.5 and TOGLL baselines.
license: No root LICENSE/GitHub SPDX declaration found. Paper CC BY 4.0; source/data upstream terms need review.
input_setting: Source + natural-language description; generates prefixes and corrects specification oracle even on synthetic-mutant source.
reproduction_grade: Conditional; code/data public, but 70B Ollama setup, no license and README/code layout mismatch.
concept_hook: Description-grounded panel oracle correction for synthetic faulty code; ablation of requirement extraction/panel consensus.
limitation: No real historical bug IDs, Defects4J/BugsInPy/SWT; mutant-based fault proxy only; no root-cause labels.
